# Disha

> Context-aware legal document navigator. Upload a legal PDF, declare your role
> and concern, and get findings that matter to you — each grounded in the
> document text or honestly marked unverified. Informational only, not legal advice.

## What it does
- Role- and concern-aware analysis of legal PDFs (India-first jurisdiction lens)
- Deterministic evidence grounding: every quoted finding is verified against the
  real document text; the model never certifies its own quotes
- "Prepare for your lawyer" question packet

## Notes
- Disha provides information, not legal advice.
- Documents are processed ephemerally and never stored.
